description: This file provides utility functions for processing OpenAI prompt messages, including type checking for token lists and transforming message lists into prompt strings or token lists.

methods.name: is_tokens_or_list_of_tokens(value: List)
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a list of integers or a list of lists of integers, indicating token data.

methods.name: AllPromptValues _transform_prompt( messages: Union[List[AllMessageValues], List[OpenAITextCompletionUserMessage]], )
methods.description: Transforms a list of message objects into an OpenAI prompt, converting messages to strings or token lists based on their content.
